analysis_policy.contrasts: All7factorial contrasts and3style controls per configuration. Matched newInstruct-minus-Base contrasts where both cells are applicable. Original0.6B is a historical configuration reference, not a pure size contrast.
analysis_policy.coverage: For every model/condition/metric report allocated, applicable and unavailable counts. Complete-speaker contrasts target only speakers with all required cells; never silently treat short-output NA as zero or equal coverage.
analysis_policy.independent_check: Cross-check each literal diagnostic with a separate direct-count implementation and compare factorial summaries using the existing second implementation. Re-run the additive analysis read-only from raw evidence; do not call this independent experimental validation.
analysis_policy.reuse: Use the existing raw-journal audits and two frozen factorial arithmetic implementations. Add only this bounded diagnostic adapter and authored edge-case tests; do not edit frozen helpers or create another general evaluator.
analysis_policy.uncertainty: Equal-context then equal-speaker arithmetic; speaker profiles and leave-one-speaker-out influence, not confidence intervals or calibrated significance. No arbitrary participant independence assumption.

original_reproduction.limits: Independent arithmetic implementations, shared journal reader; not semantic or independent experimental validation. Source bytes and private archive paths must remain available. Public clone-only reproduction PARTIAL; no cross-environment generation repeatability claim.

source_inputs.scope: All300existing English outputs: originalQwen3-0.6B100 plusQwen2.5-1.5BBase100 andInstruct100, same5development speakers and10contexts, all8factorial plus2style-control cells.

definitions.interpretation: Literal recurrence can reflect useful terminology or quotation; more output provides more repetition opportunities. These diagnostics cannot establish Persona Fidelity, factual accuracy, temporal contamination, human preference or model superiority. Different model families/templates/EOS/quantizations and fixed blocks remain confounded.
definitions.no_threshold_tuning: No success threshold, language quality score, semantic error label, inferred persona identity or example selection. Preserve all computed values including zeros, NA and negative contrasts.
definitions.prefix20_repeat5_excess: Same rate on exactly the first20 extracted words, only for responses with at least20words. A fixed-opportunity descriptive sensitivity, not output-length-adjusted causality; selection into this subset is post-treatment.
definitions.raw_empty: Indicator exact native response content equals the empty string; report all allocated and generated denominators separately. This is not missing execution.
definitions.repeat5_any: Indicator at least one duplicate consecutive five-word window, only where at least one window exists. This is literal surface recurrence, not a validated semantic repetition or degeneration label.
definitions.repeat5_excess: Use the unchanged English words() rule in english_sfh_analysis_v1.py. For consecutive five-word windows, (number of windows minus number of distinct windows)/number of windows. If fewer than5words, NA, not zero.
definitions.whitespace_empty: Indicator native content.strip() equals the empty string; do not trim or overwrite the archived response. Non-English or punctuation-only strings are not silently reclassified as empty.

limits: Post-hoc literal diagnostics, not semantic repetition, fidelity or accuracy. Short-output NA is not zero; complete-speaker subsets differ by metric. First20words equalize opportunities only in a post-treatment-selected subset. No human mapping opened, independent experimental validation, pure size effect or novelty claim.
